import type { IClock } from '#shared/providers/clock'
import type { IIdGenerator } from '#shared/providers/id-generator'
import { RefundNotAllowedError } from '#modules/billing/errors/refund-not-allowed-error'
import type { IOrdersRepository } from '#modules/billing/repositories/orders-repository'

/** Time never comes from `new Date()` here — it comes from `IClock` (R7). */
export class RefundOrderUseCase {
  constructor(
    private readonly ordersRepository: IOrdersRepository,
    private readonly clock: IClock,
    private readonly idGenerator: IIdGenerator,
  ) {}

  async execute(orderId: string) {
    const order = await this.ordersRepository.findById(orderId)
    if (order === null) throw new RefundNotAllowedError()

    // Defensive copy of a value we were given: deterministic, not a clock read.
    const refundedAt = new Date(this.clock.now().getTime())

    return { id: this.idGenerator.generate(), refundedAt }
  }
}
